basis: Static inspection of the original librsvg 2.58.93 source manifests and sharp-libvips 8.15.3 build recipe. Not a recovered binary build graph.
criticalLimitation: The build overrides zune-jpeg with ironpeak/zune-image revision eebb01b and regenerates Cargo.lock. Original source-lock versions do not establish final binary dependency versions.

groups.disposition: Outside runtime scope in original source graph
groups.evidence: anes is pulled by criterion benchmarking; difflib by predicates. librsvg declares criterion and predicates as dev-dependencies; build recipe disables tests.

groups.evidence: locale_config selects objc-foundation for target_os=macos; objc-foundation brings block, objc and objc_id; objc brings malloc_buf.

groups.evidence: winapi selects these under explicit Windows GNU target triples.

groups.evidence: half declares crunchy as a dev-dependency and for target_arch=spirv, not Linux x86_64.

groups.disposition: Feature-dependent; not automatically a shipped component
groups.evidence: These are on the rav1e/v_frame AVIF encoder path. librsvg disables image default features and exposes AVIF as an optional feature. Do not infer inclusion from Cargo.lock alone.

groups.disposition: Relevant library families; establish actual built versions
groups.evidence: Dependencies of SVG parsing/XML, lookup-table generation, or JPEG decoding. Build dependencies remain conservatively included because their generated code can contribute to runtime output.

Present in the image inventory. MPL notice in certdata.txt, MIT attribution in c_rehash.c and curl notice in mk-ca-bundle.pl were located and retained in alpine-NOTICES.txt, with provenance in coverage.json.

nextAction: Use exact build artifacts from the libvips binary producer to resolve final source coverage, rather than expanding the original-lockfile audit.
